description: This skill should be used when a session BUILDS one Genesis item: implementing a change in a worktree through to opening its PR, including rework from a send-back spec. Load `genesis-development` (the shared core) first. Do NOT load it for driving open PRs to merge (`closing-session`), post-merge verification (`validating-merges`), or specifying a change before it is planned (`spec-session`).
